title: Create case-management work items through full workflow to Approved/Rejected
description: Use the case-management app to create real work items and progress them through the full CMS workflow (duly-made review, assessment, query/response, approve/refuse), reaching two terminal states: Approved and Rejected. Update jmeter/data CSVs and case-management-journey.jmx to reflect valid, current work item IDs/state per journey step so the perf test runs cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: Two work items exist (or are creatable) that reach Approved and Rejected respectively; jmeter/data CSVs updated with valid IDs; case-management-journey.jmx runs against target env with 0% unexpected failures for the covered steps
notes:
RESOLUTION (2026-08-15): Rewrote case-management-journey.jmx to match the current v12
app workflow (per user decision: rewrite jmx only, don't chase the operator-side journey).

Changes:
  - Removed all defunct task-checklist steps (tasks/{taskId}/complete, tasks/{taskId}/status)
    and the old approve-interstitial/reject-action/withdraw-confirm routes -- all deleted
    from the app (RA-410/RA-317) and previously the real cause of the 25-33% error rates.
  - Approval (3 threads) and Refusal (2 threads) groups now: duly-make (POST payment-date-*)
    -> self-assign (auto-transitions duly-made -> assessment-in-progress) -> log-decision
    (decision=approved|rejected). Verified duly-make and self-assign genuinely transition
    state (checked MongoDB stateId directly).
  - Query (2 threads) simplified to 2 steps (was 8): GET/POST /work-items/{id}/query directly
    from 'submitted' via query-during-duly-making. Verified reaches stateId 'queried'.
  - Removed the 3 withdraw thread groups entirely (feature removed from case management,
    RA-317 -- withdraw is operator-only now and the generic action route rejects it server-side).
  - jmeter/scripts/seed-cms-work-items.sh already trimmed to 7 items (no withdraw) from
    earlier in this session.

IMPORTANT CAVEAT documented in the jmx TestPlan comment: the decision POST shows as
HTTP 200/302 "pass" in JMeter even locally, but silently does NOT change state -- verified
via MongoDB that Approve/Refuse items stay at assessment-in-progress after a "successful"
local run, because case-management-backend abandons the decision when it can't notify the
operator-backend (no linked application exists for seeded items). A green run of this plan
locally does NOT prove Approved/Rejected was reached. Query genuinely reaches 'queried'.

Full local run verified clean: 48/48 requests, 0.00% HTTP-level errors.

Not done (explicitly deferred by user): originating a real application through the
operator-facing app (epr-register-enrol-frontend) to get a genuinely linked work item that
can reach Approved/Rejected. Flagged as future work if ever needed.
close_reason: Rewrote case-management-journey.jmx to match current app workflow; documented the operator-backend-link limitation that blocks a genuine local Approved/Rejected
